lessons_used: Home wait_info changes are consistently helpful, winning 6 out of 13 tests.
Adoption redesigns are generally helpful, winning 3 out of 6 tests.
Finish hints, sign-in notifications, sign-in redesigns, choose_path layouts, and choose_path redesigns show no positive effect, frequently causing negative impacts or early test stops.
Adoption hints, home redesigns, finish layouts, finish new flows, sign-in copy, and sign-in incentives show no clear effect across multiple tests.

Categories with only 1 test (such as adoption new_flow, adoption new_screen, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint, finish reorder, home new_flow, sign_in hint, and sign_in reorder) remain thin evidence.
Predictions were systematically too low for large winning redesigns and too high for changes that produced no clear effect or negative outcomes.

lessons_next: Home wait_info changes (won 6 of 14), adoption redesigns (won 3 of 6), finish redesigns (won 1 of 2), adoption new_flows (won 1 of 2), sign_in notifications (won 1 of 3), and finish new_screens (won 1 of 5) have proven helpful in winning tests.
Finish hints, sign_in redesigns, sign_in incentives, choose_path layouts, and choose_path redesigns showed no positive effect and frequently caused negative impacts or early test stops.
Adoption hints, choose_path copy, finish layouts, finish new flows, home redesigns, and sign_in copy showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Kinds of change tested only once (adoption new_screen, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint, finish reorder, home new_flow, sign_in hint, sign_in reorder) remain thin evidence.
Predictions were systematically too low for large winning redesigns/flows and too high for changes with no clear effect or negative outcomes.
